sentences.en: I couldn't give a flying flamingo what your view is.
sentences.zh: 我才不在乎你的看法呢。

sentences.en: The flamingo is the national bird of the Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 火烈鸟是巴哈马的国鸟。

sentences.en: The distinctive colouring of the flamingo comes from carotenoids in their diet.
sentences.zh: 火烈鸟独特的颜色来自于它们饮食中的类胡萝卜素。
